Bill.BriefDescription: Changing compensation requirements for members of the governing body of diking and drainage districts.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to compensation for members of the governing bodyof diking and drainage districts; and amending RCW 85.38.075.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 85.38.075 and 1998 c 121 s 12 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The members of the governing body may each receive up to seventydollars in compensation for attendance at official meetings of thegoverning body and for each day or major part thereof for all necessaryservices actually performed in connection with their duties as amember. To be eligible to receive this compensation, the land locatedwithin the special district owned by the member of the governing bodyof that special district shall not be subject to any lien fordelinquent special assessments under RCW 85.38.178. The governing bodyshall fix the compensation to be paid to the eligible members,secretary, and all other agents and employees of the district.Compensation for the members shall not exceed six thousand sevenhundred twenty dollars in one calendar year. A member is entitled toreimbursement for reasonable expenses actually incurred in connection p. 1 SB 6337with such business, including subsistence and lodging, while away fromthe member's place of residence, and mileage for use of a privatelyowned vehicle in accordance with chapter 42.24 RCW. Any member may waive all or any portion of his or her compensationpayable under this section as to any month or months during his or herterm of office, by a written waiver filed with the secretary asprovided in this section. The waiver, to be effective, must be filedany time after the member's election and prior to the date on which thecompensation would otherwise be paid. The waiver shall specify themonth or period of months for which it is made.
